takes.name: Older teacher
takes.description: Direction: an older, warm mentor with clear, patient teaching and thoughtful authority.

request.voice_description: Preserve this recognizable warm American male voice and accent. Combine the seasoned warmth of a mentor in his early seventies with the clear, patient delivery of an excellent chess teacher. A little lived-in texture and rounded resonance, healthy and alert. Quietly intelligent and assured: precise, unforced articulation; thoughtful emphasis on the reasoning; small reflective pauses between ideas. Conversational and personable, teaching one adult across a chessboard, with a trace of dry wit. A measured but flowing pace. Let the final sentence settle naturally and pronounce the complete last word. No pompous lecture, theatrical acting, frail quaver, exaggerated rasp, breathiness, booming announcer tone, music or effects.
